name: gated-streams
description: A hybrid decoder over several residual streams (hyper-connections: each block reads a row mixed from the streams and its output is added to every stream by weights of its own) of gated delta-rule layers and gated block-sparse attention (an indexer picks the KV blocks a token reads past its budget), with zero-centred RMSNorms (1 + weight), a mixture of experts with a gated shared expert, and a multi-token-prediction layer the model drafts from
